scope: Editing-session soak over REST with a fixed pseudo-random script. Does not cover playback, export or the browser; one run.

commitLatencyMs.note: includes HTTP round trip on loopback; each commit is followed by a full project read in this harness

scaling.explanation: every commit copies, validates, diffs and stores the whole document, so cost grows with project size

checks.name: 3000 mixed transactions by two actors: no server error, the document was valid at all 30 checkpoints
history length does not slow edits: a small project in the same database, after thousands of revisions elsewhere, commits as fast as at the start of the session
project size does slow edits (measured, a known limit of whole-document commits): median 20.95 ms with 708 clips; regression guard: under 50 ms at this size

checks.name: replaying the whole operation log from an empty project reproduces the live document exactly; an earlier revision can be reconstructed and is valid
after a server restart the project reopens identical, accepts new edits, and undo history still works
the project archive restores on a second server with an empty data directory: same document (new id), media present, and a rendered frame is byte-identical to the original
